title: 2015 AMC 12B 9
statement: Larry and Julius are playing a game, taking turns throwing a ball at a bottle sitting on a ledge. Larry throws first. The winner is the first person to knock the bottle off the ledge. At each turn the probability that a player knocks the bottle off the ledge is \(\dfrac12,\) independently of what has happened before. What is the probability that Larry wins the game?

solutions.text:
Let \(x\) be the probability Larry wins. He wins right away with probability \(\dfrac12,\) or both players miss (probability \(\dfrac14\)) and the game restarts.

So \(x = \dfrac12 + \dfrac14 x,\) giving \(\dfrac34 x = \dfrac12\) and \(x = \dfrac23.\)

Thus, the correct answer is C.
hints: If both miss (probability \(\dfrac14\)), the game resets; solve \(x = \dfrac12 + \dfrac14 x\)
